decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block eligibility and the BIG_BLOCK scope context while preserving Small Block selection.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket from the no-referral reward components.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint contribution to the continuing Small Block prize pool; its other mechanics remain valid.
The existing same-message MODIFY already narrows secondary-sale prize-pool funding to SMALL_BLOCK, with no change to royalty enforcement or ticket-generation rules.
The existing same-message MODIFY already deletes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute.
Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the generic automatic wallet-transfer collection flow for remaining Small Block prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block descriptions throughout the affected FAQ fields and records the revised primary-mint allocation.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the affected How It Works copy with Small Block-only ticket and prize descriptions.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the prize-pool copy with the continuing Small Block prize and removes Big Block advertising.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records the $5 founder allocation, $5 prize-pool allocation, SMALL_BLOCK-only destination, and revised residual-allocation rule.
The generic reference to prize-draw tickets remains accurate for Small Block tickets and does not require a copy change.
Badge definitions, referral milestones, storage, and cosmetic effects are independent of the eliminated Big Block mechanism.
